units.source_text: 父亲根本理都没理我，难得的笑了笑说：

en.t: Father paid no attention to me at all, but gave a rare smile and said:

units.source_text: “也不是买烛台之类的东西，只是请他帮忙买一盏油灯……

en.t: It is not as though I am buying a candlestick or anything like that; I only want to ask him to help buy an oil lamp...

units.source_text: 由他出面买的话，应该会我买的还好吧。”

en.t: If he handles the purchase, it should turn out better than if I bought it myself.
